summary: Copies a capsule/collision shape payload (0x18 bytes from a1) into a stack AABB collision body initialized by AABBCollisionBodyInitializer, applies a small-struct copy from a2 into the same buffer, then fits a HAT polygon surface onto the result and returns the fit result. Called from sub_44B110 and BezierPatchTessellation.

operations.description: Initialize the local AABB collision body buffer v4 via AABBCollisionBodyInitializer(v4).
qmemcpy copies 0x18 bytes from the source payload a1 into the initialized AABB body buffer v4.
SmallStructCopy(v4, a2) copies the small struct at a2 into the buffer v4, overlaying the copied payload.
HATPolygonSurfaceFit(a3, v4, 0) fits a HAT polygon surface to the assembled collision body; a3 receives the fit output.
Return the integer result of HATPolygonSurfaceFit(a3, v4, 0).

unresolved: Purpose of the 0x18-byte capsule payload copied from a1 is unlabeled beyond the function name.
Semantic of the third HATPolygonSurfaceFit argument 0 is not established.
